name: SpinalCom
positioning: A building operating system — the layer that makes twenty proprietary building systems queryable as one digital twin.
description: SpinalCom publishes a building operating system that aggregates data from heterogeneous building systems — HVAC, lighting, access, metering, BIM models — into a semantic digital twin, exposed through APIs so applications can be built on top rather than integrated one by one.
real_estate_use: A smart building project usually stalls on the same wall: every subsystem speaks a different protocol and belongs to a different contractor. Placing an operating system between the equipment and the applications means the tenant app, the energy dashboard and the maintenance tool all read the same model of the building, and replacing a supplier does not break everything above it.
features: Aggregation of heterogeneous building systems and protocols
Semantic digital twin linked to the BIM model
Data historisation for energy and operations analytics

use_cases.job: Read every building subsystem through one model instead of twenty interfaces
Build tenant and energy applications on a twin that outlives a supplier change
